name: OVERHAUL Parts Catalog
tagline: Tear it down, build it back better — like a car. Earn the pink slip.
notes: Every part maps to a REAL asset in the repo/mesh. The Garage UI (tools/garage) and the flash-deployer (scripts/overhaul-deploy.sh) both read this file. Add a part = add an entry here + a case arm in overhaul-deploy.sh.

parts.label: Node bootstrap (OPK)
parts.desc: Turns any Mac/Windows box into a mesh node. Role-aware install.

parts.label: Tailscale mesh join
parts.desc: Private, owner/family-only network. No public IP, no funnel.

parts.label: Local LLM (RAM-sized)
parts.desc: Your first private LLM. setup-llm.sh picks the model by RAM (3b/8b/14b/32b).

parts.label: Brain DB (Postgres + pgvector)
parts.desc: Local memory fabric. 127.0.0.1 only. Stands up + loads schema.

parts.label: Nightly brain backup
parts.desc: launchd 3AM gzipped pg_dump; local now, NAS over Tailscale at home.

parts.label: AIXMOS agents
parts.desc: The operative agents that run the verticals (CAPTAIN, dispatch, sales).

parts.label: HAILMARY owner-proxy (always-on)
parts.desc: Owner-only always-on agent. APEX tier ($100K) — Owner only.

parts.label: TMMT Admin dashboard
parts.desc: The production admin platform (Next.js).

parts.label: Mission Control launcher
parts.desc: Holographic front door + desktop app icons.

parts.label: Clean UI / dashboard (Legacy find)
parts.desc: The cleaner dashboard/UI found on MoeLegacy — to be universalized.

parts.label: SuperWhisper voice input (Legacy find)
parts.desc: Local voice dictation → drives brain-dump + commands hands-free.

parts.label: OpenClaw / OpenClaude (Legacy find)
parts.desc: Open agent tooling set up on MoeLegacy — wrap as a portable module.

parts.label: Disk encryption (FileVault/BitLocker)
parts.desc: Encrypt at rest. Verified, never auto-toggled without owner yes.

parts.label: Secret-guard git hooks
parts.desc: Pre-commit/push block .env/keys/service-role/Stripe/GHL.

parts.label: DARK kill-switch
parts.desc: Anyone can stop; only the Owner Seal lifts. dark hard = tailscale down.

parts.label: Watchtower health
parts.desc: League roster + live vertical health pings.

parts.label: Error monitoring (Sentry)
parts.desc: Inactive until NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN set.

parts.label: Mesh sync (git coordination)
parts.desc: Keep every node + business in sync via git. Safe N-machine sync.

parts.label: Shared brain (cross-business memory)
parts.desc: TMMT + MoeLegacy write to one memory fabric so both stay in sync.

parts.label: GHL bridge (per-business)
parts.desc: Each business keeps its OWN GHL; bridge syncs leads/pipeline across orgs.

parts.label: Cross-org tenancy (TMMT + MoeLegacy)
parts.desc: Org-scoped roles/reads so two businesses share the mesh, fenced apart.

parts.label: 🚗 Car-rental vertical
parts.desc: Fleet, contracts, dispatch, AIXMOS Agents of Chaos for rentals.

parts.label: 📈 Credit guidance + funding
parts.desc: Credit GUIDANCE (never repair) + business-funding network.

parts.label: 🚑 Operation Overdrive (courier → ER fleet)
parts.desc: Mission-critical A→B logistics. Start: economy medical-courier → grow to sports/utility emergency-response fleet, drivers who don't fold. Built on dispatch-core.

parts.label: 🛒 E-commerce (managed)
parts.desc: Store managed on their behalf, inventory included (enterprise).

parts.label: Local Ollama (free, default)
parts.desc: Free, unlimited, local. Default provider for every node.

parts.label: Bring-your-own key (scoped)
parts.desc: Owner-provisioned, scoped, rotatable cloud keys. NEVER reuse found keys.
